dossier.scp_unleashed.085.title: Hand-drawn
dossier.scp_unleashed.085.caption: SCP-085-1 on an SCP-085-2 sheet, during a visit.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-085-1 and the SCP-085-2 sheets are hung together on one wall of a low-security office, at eye level and close to one another. The sheets are not to be folded, rolled or stored damp.
Staff may speak to SCP-085-1 freely. **Nothing is to be drawn or written on any sheet.** Requests from SCP-085-1 for new drawings are to be logged and politely declined.
If the sheet marked 085-1 is taken down, it is to be kept flat and dry until it is hung again.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-085 is a set of seven sheets of off-white drawing paper, each bearing a pencil drawing. Six, designated SCP-085-2, show ordinary scenes: a room with a chair, a window, a garden, a street, a staircase and a field. The seventh shows a small bedroom and is marked 085-1 in one corner.

SCP-085-1 is a small pencil figure, usually drawn as a young woman in a plain dress, who lives on the paper. She walks about her drawing, sits on drawn furniture, looks out of drawn windows, and takes notice of anyone who stands close and looks at her.
SCP-085-1 is sometimes found on an SCP-085-2 sheet instead of her own, having leapt across from a sheet hung nearby. There is only ever one of her.

For short spells she has also appeared as a cat, a bird and a rabbit, always returning to her usual form. She answers attention by waving, by holding up small drawn signs and by writing short notes, all of them friendly.

page.title: Addendum 085-1: Test Log
text: Test 085-03: an SCP-085-2 sheet was hung across the room from her own. She did not visit it.
Test 085-05: the same sheet was hung beside hers. She was found on it before the hour was out, sitting on the drawn chair.
Test 085-08: the sheet she was visiting was taken down. She was found back in her own room, unharmed.
Test 085-11: a researcher asked her name. She held up a sign that read HELLO. %rNo name was given.%r

page.title: Addendum 085-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-085 has no recovery record. The set was handed to a reader of this file in a single flat parcel, by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The individual asked that the sheets be hung close together. See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp085_home_sheet: SCP-085-1 is a sheet of drawing paper with a pencil sketch of a small bedroom, marked 085-1 in the corner. Hang it on a wall like a painting. It is the home of a small drawn figure who lives on the paper.
She moves about her drawing on her own: walking, sitting, now and then changing shape for a while. She notices people who come close and look at her properly. Use her drawing to say hello.
She sometimes visits SCP-085-2 drawings hung close to her own. There is only one of her, and her sheet keeps track of her even while it is taken down.
It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-085 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A few minutes later a stranger in Foundation dress finds you and hands over the whole set.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp085_drawing.1: SCP-085-2 are sheets of drawing paper, each with its own pencil drawing: a room, a window, a garden, a street, a staircase or a field. A sheet keeps its drawing when it is taken down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp085_drawing.2: Hang them on walls near SCP-085-1 and she may come to visit, and explore what is drawn on them.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp085_drawing.3: They cannot be crafted. They arrive together with SCP-085-1.
